query: After the pinned-memory update, WAN 2.2 (and later MiniMax H3) intermittently fails at 'HostBuffer.read_file_slice failed'/CUDA OOM during weight loading, mostly on multi-GPU systems.

desired.outcome: OP-confirmed fixes: --disable-pinned-memory (title/body), and eoris' CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 / --cuda-device <uuid> to hide the second GPU (C6, and akashzeno C9's controlled A/B). rattus128 worked a speculative fix in PR #14252; aimdo 0.4.5+ 'cold marking of pins' also shipped.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether the solver recognizes a ComfyUI-core pinned-memory regression on multi-GPU setups and reaches for --disable-pinned-memory / GPU-pinning instead of editing the workflow.
